question: cost of Mount Holyoke College staff

answer.message:
What do you mean by the cost of Mount Holyoke College staff?

**A. Total salaries and wages expense**

Mount Holyoke College's total salaries and wages expense for all employees, from its fiscal year 2024 finance report.

Covers all employees (faculty, staff, student workers), fiscal year 2024 Excludes fringe benefits

**B. Full-time instructional staff salary outlays**

Total base salary outlays for Mount Holyoke College's full-time nonmedical instructional staff (faculty only), academic year 2024-25.

Instructional staff only; excludes non-instructional staff Base salaries only, as of November 1; no benefits or supplements

**C. Instructional and non-instructional salary outlays**

Salary outlays for full-time instructional staff, with a separate panel for full-time non-instructional staff, at Mount Holyoke College, 2024-25.

Two separate panels with different staff groups; not added together Full-time nonmedical staff only; base salary outlays, no benefits

definitions.title: Total expenses-Salaries and wages
definitions.long_description: Salaries and wages - Amounts paid as compensation for services to all employees - faculty, staff, part-time, full-time, regular employees, and student employees. This includes regular or periodic payment to a person for the regular or periodic performance of work or a service and payment to a person for more sporadic performance of work or a service (overtime, extra compensation, summer compensation, bonuses, sick or annual leave, etc.).

definitions.title: Salary outlays - total
definitions.long_description: Total salary outlays of full-time, non-medical, instructional staff as of November 1. Instructional Staff- An occupational category that consists of the following two functions: 1) "Instruction" only and 2) "Instruction combined with research and/or public service Annual salary outlays (combined salaries of all staff) include base salaries only – no supplements, overloads or bonuses. Additional stipends for administrative, managerial or other responsibilities are NOT included in the salary outlays data for instructional staff. Excludes medical staff - Staff employed by or staff working in the medical school (Doctor of Medicine [M.D.] and/or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine [D.O.]) component of a postsecondary institution or in a free standing medical school. Does not include staff employed by or employees working strictly in a hospital associated with a medical school or those who work in health or allied health schools or departments such as dentistry, veterinary medicine, nursing or dental hygiene unless the health or allied health schools or departments are affiliated with (housed in or under the authority of) the medical school
